# UniMARKY

> UniMARKY is a campus platform for verified university students. One student account covers a campus marketplace, communities, study material, accommodation, food and lost & found, scoped to the student's university.

## Product

- Marketplace: buy and sell textbooks, electronics, hostel gear and services with students at the same university.
- Communities: clubs, batches and campus events, run by students.
- Study: notes, previous-year papers and course resources by subject and semester.
- Accommodation: PGs, hostels and flats near campus.
- Food: campus restaurants, menus and student favourites.
- Lost & Found: report lost items or return found ones with photos and locations.

## Key pages

- Home: https://unimarky.runs-on.dev/

- Privacy: https://unimarky.runs-on.dev/privacy

## Notes

Product inventory (listings, community posts, menus) is available to signed-in students and is not public. Public pages describe the platform and link to the app.
